home.howTitle: How the AI face age test works

steps.title: Upload a photo or turn on the camera
steps.text: Upload a clear, front-facing photo with one face, or turn on your camera and look into it.

steps.title: AI analyzes it in your browser
steps.text: The AI finds your face, then a TensorFlow.js model trained with Google Teachable Machine compares the photo with six age groups. Photos and video never leave your device.

steps.title: See your estimated age
steps.text: You get an estimated age and the probability for each group, from baby to fifties.

faq.a: The model gives a probability for six age groups (baby, teens, twenties, thirties, forties, fifties). Your estimated age is the average of each group’s representative age (5, 15, 25, 35, 45, 55) weighted by those probabilities.

faq.q: Are my photos or camera video uploaded or stored?
faq.a: No. Photos and camera video are analyzed entirely in your browser with TensorFlow.js. Nothing is sent to a server or saved, and it is gone when you leave the page.
It is a test for fun, not a medical or legal age assessment. Lighting, camera angle, makeup and facial expression can all change the result.

faq.q: What kind of photo works best?
faq.a: A bright, front-facing photo with only one face and nothing covering it gives the most consistent results.
Yes. It is free, needs no sign-up and works on phones, tablets and computers.

about.title: What is AI Face Age Test?
about.intro: The AI Face Age Test is a service that uses cutting-edge machine learning technology to analyze uploaded photos and estimate the apparent age of faces. Built on Google's Teachable Machine platform, this system has been trained on extensive facial data to provide accurate age predictions.

how.title: How Does It Work?
how.lead: Our AI system operates through the following process:
items: Face Detection: Automatically identifies facial regions in uploaded images
Feature Analysis: Analyzes age-related characteristics such as wrinkles, skin texture, and facial contours
AI Prediction: Machine learning model predicts age based on analyzed features
Result Display: Shows estimated age along with probability graphs by age group

features.title: Fast Analysis
features.text: Get results within seconds after uploading your photo

features.title: Privacy Protection
features.text: Uploaded photos are not stored on servers and are immediately deleted after analysis

features.title: All Device Support
features.text: Works on PC, tablets, smartphones, and all devices

features.title: Intuitive Interface
features.text: Simple and beautiful interface that anyone can easily use

results.title: Understanding Results
results.lead: Test results are provided as follows:
items: Estimated Age: The most likely age as analyzed by AI
Age Group Probability: Bar chart showing probability of belonging to each age group from teens to 50s

caution.title: Important Notes
items: This test is created for entertainment purposes and cannot be used for medical or legal purposes
Lighting, angle, and facial expression may affect results
For the most accurate results, please use bright photos facing forward
It's recommended to use photos with only one face at a time

tech.title: Technical Background
tech.text: This service is built on Google's Teachable Machine 2.0 platform. Using TensorFlow.js, it runs directly in the browser, so photos are not sent to servers, ensuring your privacy is safely protected.

cta.title: Try the Test Now!
cta.text: If you're curious about your facial age, start the test right now.

privacy.intro: This policy explains what information the AI Face Age Test (the “Service”) handles and how.

sections.title: Personal information we collect
sections.text: The Service has no accounts and does not collect or store information that identifies you, such as your name, email or phone number. We do not share personal information with third parties or outsource its processing.

sections.title: Photos and camera video
sections.text: Photos you upload and camera video are analyzed only inside your browser. They are never sent to a server or stored, and they disappear when you close the page. The camera is used only after you tap “Turn on camera”.

sections.title: Cookies and third-party services
sections.text: For visit statistics and ads, the following services may collect information through cookies: Google Analytics (statistics), Google AdSense and Kakao AdFit (ads). That information is handled under each company’s policy: Google, Kakao.

sections.title: How to refuse cookies
sections.text: You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, and turn off personalized ads in Google Ad Settings. The test works the same without cookies.

sections.title: Data stored in your browser
sections.text: Only your dark mode setting is saved in your browser (localStorage).

sections.title: Retention
sections.text: The Service itself keeps no personal information. Data collected by third-party services is kept according to their own policies.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can ask to view, correct, delete or stop the processing of your personal information. Contact us below and we will act without delay.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.text: If this policy changes, we will announce it on this page 7 days before it takes effect.
